# Living curtain caller baseline

These files are byte-for-byte snapshots of the automation migration baseline commit
`692d615a32bdafd9f26ab3b56d2ed3cc1dc0dc64`, before the living-curtain caller changes.
They let contract tests compare the pinned current rules with their original
behavior without fetching old Git history or changing Git ownership trust.

- `027.yaml`: `config/027_curtains_close_in_the_evening.yaml`; SHA-256 `a5f14cff6af5c3b6116f3e3d0a4d55ebecfd91a2333c5f0091295b03a81b1e25`.
- `029.yaml`: `config/029_curtains_close_sheer_curtains_in_the_evening.yaml`; SHA-256 `64af6ff2f0dae697ad7fd5e710c59e914abc25a063a0b91e27ef24291b9509b5`.
- `077.yaml`: `config/077_curtains_open_living_room_curtains_in_the_morning.yaml`; SHA-256 `4e2435c17159374dda6a7d3c2a8bd23e6ed09be51bace5bd2aea92aacde53635`.
